conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You, as investigators, arrived in Trieste pursuing Winkelmann's clues. At the university, you learned he had long passed away. Later, at the museum Gem Garden, you discovered his sarcophagus and a display case with seven medals, noticing an empty slot. Guided by a stray cat to discover anomalies, you visited Antonio Termona, obtained the address of translator Montanelli, and borrowed an ancient book. On the return journey, you encountered the Bora wind and clashes with Blackshirts, rescuing the injured stray cat Gousheng. Now arriving at the city library, a suspicious vehicle appears behind you. player6 spots a bat on the roof, and player4 is warily scanning the surroundings.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #First to Enter the Library

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 pushes open the heavy oak door, greeted by the mixed scent of aged paper and floor wax. The lofty hall is lined with twenty-foot-tall wrought-iron bookshelves. A librarian in a gray smock glides a rolling ladder across the parquet floor. Dust slowly swirls in the light cast through the stained-glass dome. Behind the lending desk hangs an etched portrait of Franz Joseph I, with an Italian notice for silence pasted below the frame.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #After entering the library, prepare to look up information about that father of archaeology, and also, why and how he died at the time.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Deep in the reading area sits a man with his arms hidden inside his jacket, staring at the open pages like a statue. A uniformed attendant comes periodically to turn the pages for him; the sound of paper rubbing is particularly clear in the silence. Not far away, three Turks wearing fezzes sit together, the black tassels of their crimson caps dangling over the edges of books. On the spiral staircase stands a tall, slender figure with fiery red hair, a streak of black like a burn mark. He is running his fingers along the spines of books in the law section.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The red-haired man hesitantly takes out a match for Caesar Druni. The smoke he exhales carries a strange sandalwood scent. His gaze avoids eye contact, and his right hand unconsciously twists the ends of his hair. After the match goes out, he quickly puts his hand back into his trench coat pocket.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take a deep drag first. "player5" #Turn head and look directly at this man, first judging his ethnicity.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 notices the other has typical Northern Italian features—olive skin and a Roman-style high nose bridge—but that head of red hair clearly comes from genetic inheritance in the Veneto region.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Is he a local here?)

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 observes that the fine wrinkles at the corners of his eyes are concentrated at the temples rather than below the eyelids, a common skin characteristic for Mediterranean men around forty. Although the joints of his hands appear slightly rough, they show no age spots yet. The sporadic white strands mixed in his stubble match this age range.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Were you looking something up? Forgive my curiosity, but not many people come to the library in this weather. You must have something quite urgent?"

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: "Yeah, maybe we can help."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar's cigarette almost slips from his hand. "Ah... yes, it's for my nephew, looking for nautical almanacs... He insists on writing some... uh... paper on Trieste harbor tides..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "For something like this, would you like me to contact the local university for you? My friend has some connections."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar shook his head vigorously, red hair flinging sweat droplets. No need! He... has already dropped out. His fingers crushed the cigarette out of shape. Now he keeps accounts for fishing boats... He pointed into the distance. Looks like fog is rolling in, I have to go deliver rain gear! Then he turned and quickly left.
